newsitem.title: UK: UK's Crown Leisure raises funds, plans share float.
newsitem.headline: UK's Crown Leisure raises funds, plans share float.

text.p: UK gaming machine distributor Crown Leisure Plc said on Friday it raised 5.0 million stg through an institutional placing and planned to list its shares on the London Stock Exchange.

The company said about 9.7 million ordinary shares were placed at 77p per share, including 6.5 million issued by Crown and 3.2 million sold by NatWest Ventures, which provided development capital to Crown in 1993.
Crown estimated its pretax profit would rise to 1.4 million stg for the year ended September 30 compared to 1.2 million in the previous year.
The company said it would use proceeds from the placing to repay debt and increase investment in its businesses.
It expected dealing in its shares to begin no later than December 19.
